description: SOURCE SOUGHT NOTICE - Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) for VA Medical Clinic This announcement requests information from industry to support market research and preliminary acquisition planning for the procurement described below. The purpose of this notice is to assess industry interest and identify potential sources with the capabilities and qualifications to meet the following requirements. This is not a solicitation for proposals. No contract will be awarded from this notice. No proposals are being requested or accepted with this notice. REQUIREMENT The agency is seeking information on domestic sources of supply for two types of Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) backups with salient characteristics described below: Type One Quantity 3 ea. Shall have at least 2000 Watts Output Shall have minimum surge capacity of 4,000 watts Made in America Must include at least 2 120V NEMA 5-20 duplex receptacles Dimensions cannot exceed be 91 H X 14 W X 10 D ±6 , in any direction Shall have single-phase 120 VAC, 60 Hz output Shall be capable of providing 88 hours of running time for a single half-size pharmaceutical refrigerator Shall be designed for operation in healthcare environments Automatic backup power activation transfer time shall be less than 20 milliseconds Shall be designed for indoor installation Must be capable of being wall mounted due to space limitations in the medication alcoves Shall provide a pure sine wave output suitable for medical-grade refrigeration, electronic controls, monitoring systems, and other sensitive healthcare equipment. Shall operate from a standard 120 VAC, 20-amp utility circuit and shall utilize a NEMA 5-20P connection or equivalent. Type Two Quantity 1 ea. Shall have at least 3000 Watts Output (Qty = 1) Shall have minimum surge capacity of 6,000 watts Made in America Must include at least 2 120V NEMA 5-20 duplex receptacles Dimensions cannot exceed 91 H X 55 W X 10 D ±6 any direction Shall have single-phase 120 VAC, 60 Hz output Shall be capable of providing 88 hours of running time for a single full-size pharmaceutical refrigerator Shall be designed for operation in healthcare environments Automatic backup power activation transfer time shall be less than 20 milliseconds Shall be designed for indoor installation Shall provide a pure sine wave output suitable for medical-grade refrigeration, electronic controls, monitoring systems, and other sensitive healthcare equipment. Shall operate from a standard 120 VAC, 20-amp utility circuit and shall utilize a NEMA 5-20P connection or equivalent. Interested parties who can provide the products described are requested to submit the following information: Company name, address and point of contact with phone number, SAM Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), Product information documenting salient characteristics, Socio-economic status to identify the business class as a large business, SDVOSB, VOSB, small business, Woman Owned, etc., Place of manufacture, Any other pertinent company documentation. Note: All interested parties must be registered in SAM (System for Award Management) to be eligible for the award of a Government contract. Send submissions via email to Brian.Rosciszewski@VA.gov., reference 36C25027Q0037 is email subject. Firms that respond to this Sources Sought notice but do not provide ALL the requested information may not be considered by the Government when making acquisition decisions. This market research is for informational and planning purposes. This is not a solicitation and does not obligate the Government to issue a solicitation. Please be advised that the government will not pay any costs for responses and information submitted. Respondents may not be notified of the results of this notice; it is at the discretion of the Government to release any results. ** End of Sources Sought Notice **

title: Q523--FY27: Intraoperative Neuromonitoring (IONM) Services
description: Pre-solicitation Notice: Intraoperative Neuromonitoring (IONM) Services The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), VISN 08, Bay Pines VA Healthcare System (BPVAHCS) located at 10000 Bay Pines Blvd, Bay Pines, FL 33744, intends to solicit a Request for Quotation (RFQ) as a 100% Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) set-aside, to provide services necessary to perform Intraoperative Neuromonitoring (IONM) Services to eligible beneficiaries of the BPVAHCS, under an Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract, for a base plus four (4) one year option periods. The contractor must furnish all personnel to include offsite (remote) Board-Certified Neurophysiologist Physician(s) services and onsite IONM Technologist(s) services, equipment, and supplies to provide Intraoperative Neuromonitoring (IONM) services to eligible beneficiaries of BPVAHCS. The contractor s onsite IONM technologist(s) and remote Neurophysiologist physician(s) must cover the range of IONM services as would be provided in a state-of-the-art civilian medical treatment facility and the standard of care must be of a quality, meeting or exceeding currently recognized national standards American Association for Neurological Surgeons (AANS) and American Board of Registration of Electroencephalographic and Evoked Potential Technologists (ABRET). The Contractor must quote a minimum of four (4) key personnel to be credentialed and be available for scheduling to meet the requirements of the contract, two (2) IONM Technologists and two (2) Neurophysiologist Physicians. QUALIFICATIONS: License: The Contractor s Neurophysiologist physician(s) assigned by the Contractor to perform the services covered by this contract must have a current license to practice medicine in any State, Territory, or Commonwealth of the United States or the District of Columbia) when services are performed onsite on VA property. All licenses held by the personnel working on this contract must be full and unrestricted licenses. Contractor s physician(s) who have current, full and unrestricted licenses in one or more states, but who have, or ever had, a license restricted, suspended, revoked, voluntarily revoked, voluntarily surrendered pending action or denied upon application will not be considered for the purposes of this contract. Board Certification: All Contractor s Neurophysiologist physician(s) must be Board Certified by the American Board of Neurological Surgery (ABNS) http://www.abns.org/content/default.asp and possess a certificate of Fellowship in Intraoperative Neuromonitoring. All Contractor s IONM technologists must hold a certificate (be certified) of Neurophysiologic Interoperative Monitoring (CNIM) from the American Board of Registration of Electroencephalographic and Evoked Potential Technologists (ABRET). All Contractor s Neurophysiologist physician(s) and IONM technologist(s) must be currently certified in Basic Life Support (BLS), Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) or equivalency. All continuing education courses required for maintaining certification must always be kept up to date. Documentation verifying current certification must be provided by the Contractor to the VA COR on an annual basis for each year of contract performance. Credentialing and Privileging: Credentialing and privileging is to be done in accordance with the provisions of VHA Directive 1100.20 and VHA Directive 1100.21 referenced above. The Contractor is responsible for ensuring that proposed physician(s) and technologist(s) possess the requisite credentials enabling the granting of privileges. The period of performance is expected to be from March 01, 2027, through February 29, 2032. The authority of for this procurement is Title 38 USC 8153, Health Care Resources (HCR) Sharing Authority, Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 12 Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services in combination with FAR part 19 IAW FAR Overhaul 12. 103. The solicitation document will be issued as Request for Quotation (RFQ) 36C24827Q0032 as a 100% small business set-aside solicitation on or about October 30, 2026. If an award cannot be made to a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business, the solicitation will be cancelled, and the requirement resolicited. Interested contractors will be responsible for downloading copies of the solicitation and any subsequent amendments from this website. No hard copies will be made available. The solicitation will provide instructions to contractors about the response to the RFQ submission process. Prospective contractors are encouraged to register their interest in the solicitation on the SAM.gov | Contract Opportunities website so that they are notified of the issuance of the solicitation and any amendments. In accordance with FAR 52.204-7, System for Award Management (SAM), prospective contractors must be registered in SAM to be eligible for award. Contractors may obtain SAM information at https://sam.gov/. Registration is free and potential quoters are encouraged to visit the SAM website (SAM.gov | Entity Information). The NAICS Code for this procurement is 621111 Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists); Product/Service Code: Q523 Medical- Surgery. The Business Size Standard is $16 million. Any questions concerning this announcement should be directed to Rosetta Quinn, Contract Specialist via email at rosetta.quinn@va.gov and include the solicitation number on subject line (36C24827Q0032).

title: Indefinite Delivery Contract for Architect and Engineering (A-E) Services for Surveying and Mapping Services to Support the Jacksonville District and USACE
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Jacksonville District is issuing this sources sought synopsis as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support this requirement for Indefinite Delivery Contract for Architect and Engineering (A-E) Services for Surveying and Mapping Services to Support the Jacksonville District and USACE. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code assigned to this procurement is 541370. There is no solicitation at this time. This request for capability information does not constitute a request for proposals; submission of any information in response to this market survey is purely voluntary; the Government assumes no financial responsibility for any costs incurred. The purpose of this synopsis is to gain knowledge of interest, capabilities and qualifications of various members of the Surveying Community to include Small Business Section 8(a), Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), Women-Owned (WOSB), Historically Underutilized (HUBZone) concerns and Other than Small Business Community (unrestricted). The Government must ensure there is adequate competition among the potential pool of responsible contractors. This scope for AE services will consist of surveying and mapping to support planning, engineering design, construction, operations, and maintenance of civil works projects. Work will include but not be limited to topographic surveying, property/boundary surveys, geodetic control surveys, remote sensing surveys, construction surveys, inland hydrographic surveying, and near-shore hydrographic surveying. The primary purpose of this proposed contract is to provide services for projects located within that portion of the State of Florida that resides in the geographic boundaries of the Jacksonville District area of responsibility. The anticipated contract will be an Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity contract for a period of one year from date of award, with options to extend up to four additional years; not to exceed a total of five years. description: Naval Air System Command (NAVAIR), PMX-280 Tactical Tomahawk, Patuxent River, MD, intends to negotiate and award a sole-source Contract for the Low-Rate Initial Production (LRIP) of the Joint Multiple Effects Warhead System (JMEWS) to Raytheon Company, (Raytheon) Tucson, AZ 85756-9367. The Government is seeking information from qualified businesses on their ability to meet manufacturing, material, performance, testing, and quality assurance requirements applicable to these parts. Government-Furnished drawings, Technical Data Packages (TDPs), and 3D CAD models will not be uploaded or provided with this notice. Interested vendors shall submit requested information in PDF format via email to hannah.m.forsyth.civ@us.navy.mil no later than 22 October 2026 at 4:00 PM EST. Manufacturing Capabilities & Subcontracting: Description of direct capabilities in additive manufacturing, or identification of intentions to utilize subcontractors/partners for additive manufacturing operations. PROJECT 1: RENOVATE NASIC MAIN CAMPUS, PHASE 1, F/10853 - This project is renovation of 170,000 SF of Sensitive and/or Special Access Program spaces. The work consists of the full renovation of F/10853 through reconfiguration and interior renovation to create a network of administrative functions. The work shall be done in accordance with Intelligence Community Directive 705 (ICD 705) criteria and standards. The interior demolition consists of removal of all architectural and mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) elements including floor, wall, and ceiling finishes. Work includes replacement of building systems, reconfiguration of interior partitions, life safety systems, roof replacement, and envelope modification. The roofing system will be replaced with an energy-compliant system. Penetrations will be added to the building for daylighting, and the exterior envelope will be modified on first floor locations for mechanical rooms. All piping and sprinklers that are part of the current fire protection system are to be replaced. All domestic water, storm, and sanitary piping will be replaced. Additionally, this project includes cybersecurity measures. A corridor bridge connecting F/10828 and F/10856 over an existing loading dock is to be constructed. Personnel will require swing space during the renovation of F/10853. Swing space will be provided through existing available spaces throughout the NASIC IPC campus or via a temporary facility. It is critical that the sequencing of repair work be considered so that available spaces are not overwhelmed. Estimated Acquisition Magnitude: Approximately $160,000,000 PROJECT 2: Advanced Materials Research Laboratory � C2A - Construction of an approximately ~90,000 SF three-story laboratory and research facility, as well as the potential construction of a central utility plant for the Air Force Reach Labor Material and Manufacturing Directorate. The interior shall consist of open inter-disciplinary collaboration labs with clean utilities, vibration isolation, precision HVAC and humidity controls, as well as fire protection/suppression, intrusion detections systems and medium voltage switchgear (i.e. 12,470 volts). Site work consists of utilities, sidewalks, parking, communications The new facility shall connect to existing facilities and demolitions of facility 20654. is part of this project. Estimated Acquisition Magnitude: Approximately $122,000,000 PROJECT 3: Compressor Research Facility Systems Modernization This project will modernize the Air Force Research Lab�s (AFRL) Compressor Research Facility (CRF) by replacing legacy drive and power equipment with a new 30,000-horsepower Variable Frequency Drive system to support engine component testing. The effort will deliver a fully integrated system that improves reliability, control, maintainability, and long-term test capability. Work includes replacement of the existing drive system with a new 30,000-horsepower VFD with active front end, a new 30,000-horsepower brushless synchronous motor, a new primary transformer, medium-voltage switchgear, protective relaying, and all associated interconnecting cables, bus work, grounding, and terminations. The project also includes the demolition and removal of legacy electrical and mechanical equipment; upgrades to controls, monitoring interfaces, cooling and ventilation systems, and supporting electrical infrastructure; and any required structural, foundation, enclosure, or fire/life-safety modifications needed to install and operate the new equipment. Additional work will include system integration, testing, commissioning, performance verification, operator and maintainer training, and delivery of technical data, recommended spare parts, and warranty support. Estimated Acquisition Magnitude: $25,000,000 PROJECT 4: Consolidate/Demo F/31240 This project will decentralize Area A heating by replacing the aging high-temperature hot water (HTHW) system fed from Building F/31240, Line A, and Line D with standalone boiler plants serving 49 facilities. The project supports administrative, warehouse, laboratory, hangar, and dormitory buildings that require year-round hot water for heating, reheating, humidity control, and climate management. Work includes facility surveys, evaluation of mechanical room capacity and code compliance, and determination of any needed interior renovations or limited additions to support the new equipment. The project also includes demolition of Building F/31240 and its boiler equipment, removal of above-ground HTHW piping and supports, and capping and abandonment of below-grade piping in place. New high-efficiency boiler systems, pumps, controls, and related accessories will be installed at affected facilities, with evaluation of both natural gas-fired and electric options. Additional work includes mechanical room modifications, make-up water assemblies where needed, upgrades to electrical, fire alarm, fire suppression, and direct digital control systems, and site restoration including pavement repair, grass restoration, and backfill and seeding at the demolished plant site. Estimated Acquisition Magnitude: $66,500,000 PROJECT 5: Consolidate/Demo West Ramp This project will decentralize heating for the West Ramp area at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base by replacing the existing high-temperature hot water (HTHW) system from Building F/34019 with standalone boiler plants serving 15 surrounding facilities. The effort addresses aging and degraded infrastructure supporting administrative, laboratory, and active hangar facilities that require year-round hot water for comfort heating, reheating, humidity control, and climate management. The project includes surveying each facility to determine boiler locations, evaluating mechanical room walls for code compliance, and assessing whether mechanical room expansions, electrical upgrades, or system improvements are needed to support the new equipment. Work includes demolition and removal of Building F/34019 and its internal boiler equipment, along with demolition of the exterior emergency generator, tank, piping, and all above-ground HTHW piping, supports, and foundations. REQUIREMENTS GENERAL REQUIREMENTS: The Contractor shall provide at the contractors facility the necessary repair labor, new and serviceable reworked repair parts, materials and test equipmentand arrange for outside services as required to return the equipment to a serviceable condition within the calendar day shop time as specified in the delivery schedule of the contract. SCOPE OF WORK FOR REPAIR: The scope of the work in the following subparagraphs are applicable to the latest configuration of the Government equipment.There shall be a 100% repair rate on all CLIN carcasses. Any carcass that cannot be repaired must have Defense Contract Mnagement Command (DCMC) Quality Assurance Representative(QAR) approval for disposal. Upon receipt of Government equipment the contractor shall perform incoming inspections, recording any shipping damage, and inventory components for completeness. Units with missing parts will not be inducted until missing partsare received or unless specifically authorized by the Procurment Contracting Officer (PCO). The contractor shall advise the PCO if any portion of the required servicing is a result of the furnishing by the contractor of articles that were defective in material and/or workmanship or otherwise not in conformance with the requirements of the contract under which such government equipment were originally furnished. In the event that the failed assembly is found to be beyond economical repair (BER), as defined in the contract, or in the event that the Government equipment is received with one or more subassemblies missing (FOR EXAMPLE: AS ARESULT OF CANNABALIZATION BY AN AIRCRAFT OPERATING SITE),the contractor shall promptly obtain confirmation of such findings from the cognizant DCMC QAR. and upon confirmation promptly notify the PCO for authority to scrap if BER and,if missing subassemblies, proceed IAW Missing on Induction (MOI).Units with missing parts will not be inducted until missing parts are received or unless specifically authorized by the PCO. All disassembly, repair and assembly of the Government equipment shall be IAW current engineering drawings and configuration specifications. All detail parts shall be inspected IAW the applicable repair specification and repaired or replaced as indicated. Replaced hardware shall be in accordance with the latest drawing revisions.The contractor shall provide and may use new or repaired/reworked parts which meet the requirements of the repair specification to restore the Government equipment in the delivery time specified in the contract. Repaired/reworked parts shall be used in lieu of new whenever possible as allowed by the applicable repair specification.Any repair of lower assemblies and/or detail parts not authorized by the by the applicable repair specification shall be submitted to the QAR for Government review and approval.Requests for repair approvals shall be accompanied by details of the repair and other applicable data such as tests which have been performed to validate the repair. Repaired Government equipment shall meet the inspection and acceptance test requirements of the applicable repair specifications. A contractor QA representative shall be required, in accordance with MIL-I-45208A, or ISO Quality standard equivalent, to witness repair,inspection, and acceptance tests Government representatives shall be notified of, and permitted to witnesssuch inspections at their discretion. The contractor shall submit repair procedures for Government approval prior to repair if those procedures deviate from the repair procedures detailed in the applicable repair specifications. Where the test specifications are found to be missing,inadequate,or behind in revision for a CLIN,the contractor shall develop and submit its own acceptance test procedures for Government approval to submission of the CLIN for Government acceptance. During the repair effort the contractor shall make no modifications to the CLIN that would prohibit future repair or require additional repair steps by other qualified sources. REPAIR PARTS: The contractor shall be responsible for identification, selection, ordering, and stocking of required piece parts to support all repairs. By definition," piece part" shall be any part or material listed in the applicable repair specification. TEST EQUIPMENT: The contractor will provide a laboratory facility equipped with instrumentation and testing capability for comprehensive functional testing of the equipment and detailed inspections of subassemblies and detailed parts. The contractor test equipment shall be designed to ensure repaired Government equipment function in full compliance with the requirementsof the applicable repair specification. All Government equipment's electrical performance and mechanical parameters shall be measured in accordance with the requirements of the applicable repair specification,with hard copy reports of all measurements available to the Government upon request. title: Romania – Refuse collection services – CONTRACT DE DELEGARE PRIN CONCESIUNE A GESTIUNII SERVICIULUI PUBLIC DE SALUBRIZARE DIN ORASUL BRAGADIRU, COLECTAREA SEPARATA SI TRANSPORT DESEURI MUNICIPALE SI A ALTOR FLUXURI, SALUBRIZARE STRADALA, DESZAPEZIRE si SERVICII DDD
description: Descrierea succintă a CONTRACTULUI DE DELEGARE A GESTIUNII SERVICIULUI PUBLIC DE SALUBRIZARE DIN ORASUL BRAGADIRU COLECTAREA SEPARATA SI TRANSPORTUL DESEURI MUNICIPALE SI A ALTOR FLUXURI, SALUBRIZARE STRADALA DESZAPEZIRE SI SERVICII DDD care presupune delegarea prin atribuirea unui contract de concesiune a activitatilor mai sus mentionate pe raza Orasului bragadiru prevăzută in Legea nr. 101/2006 a serviciului de salubrizare a localităţilor cat si in Ordonanţa de urgenţă nr. 92/2021 privind regimul deşeurilor). În cadrul serviciului de salubrizare, sunt cuprinse următoarele activități ce se vor realiza pe raza teritoriala a Orasului BRAGADIRU: A. Colectarea separata si transportul deseurilor municipale (inclusiv similare) reziduale; B. Colectarea separata si transportul deseurilor municipale (inclusiv similare) biodegradabile (biodeseuri); C. Colectarea separata si transportul deseurilor municipale (inluciv similare) reciclabile si din ambalaje; D. title: AN/UPX-50 Common Core Digital Interrogator (CCDI) Productionization
description: 1. INTRODUCTION THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. It is a market research tool being used to determine potential and eligible businesses capable of providing the services described herein prior to determining the method of acquisition and issuance of a Request for Proposal. The Government is not obligated to and will not pay for any information received from potential sources because of this notice. The Naval Air Systems Command, (NAVAIR) Patuxent River, Maryland, Air Traffic Management Systems Program Office (PMA-213) intends to award a Basic Ordering Agreement (BOA) order for the productionization of the AN/UPX-50 Common Core Digital Interrogator (CCDI). This includes transitioning from lab-built prototypes to units that can be produced in an electronics manufacturing environment, the development of unique CCDI test equipment and procedures, as well as integration of the CCDI into existing DI test equipment to ensure the CCDI meets all specified requirements. Lastly, this effort includes Automated Switch-Over (ASO) production line development, a CCDI Re-Spin option, and a CCDI Unknown Trouble Report (TR) corrections option. The anticipated period of performance is 32 months with an estimated value of $47M. The work associated with this requirement is expected to be performed at the contractor�s facilities within the United States. No work at Government sites is anticipated. The specific place(s) of performance will be determined based on the location of the contractor selected for any resulting contract. 2.0 BACKGROUND Production of AN/UPX-50(C) DI systems is currently performed on the N00019-23-C-0046 contract by BAE Systems, Information and Electronic Systems Integration. The existing contract is a Firm Fixed Price type. The AN/UPX-50(C) is a DI for ground-based shipboard weapon system platforms to satisfy Mark XIIA IFF and Mode S requirements. Technical refresh of the AN/UPX-50(C) DI system to the CCDI system is currently performed on the N0001922G0009 N0001923F0023 Cost Plus Fixed Fee BOA Order. The technical refresh effort includes the redesign of the AN/UPX-50(C) DI assemblies to resolve parts obsolescence and implement solutions to achieve compliance with the latest specifications, qualification, and certification standards. 3.0 REQUIRED CAPABILITIES Supplies and services to be procured will support the Navy�s requirement of AN/UPX 50 CCDI EDMs beginning in December 2027 to support production deliveries in December 2030 to active new ship production lines including:CVN, DDG, LHA, LHD, LPD, WMSL, and WMSM ship classes. These efforts require highly specialized skills and knowledge of the CCDI system design and engineering details to meet the stringent schedule. Productionization of the CCDI includes integration of highly complex Contractor developed algorithms in conjunction with Government cooperation using organically developed algorithms for target processing. This system is specialized for operation with the Aegis Weapon System (AWS) and Ship�s Self Defense System (SSDS), involving characterization of the system of systems in their operational environment to ensure ship requirements are met. This effort is intended to complete Non-Recurring Engineering activities, which are already in progress. Productionization will include the development and integration of highly specialized test equipment to ensure equipment meets all specified requirements. BAE Systems is the sole designer, developer and manufacturer of DI and has been the only entity producing the AN/UPX-50(C) DI for over 10 years. BAE Systems retains the Technical Data Package (TDP). Interested parties must include a detailed explanation of how they would complete the CCDI Productionization requirements without a Government furnished TDP. Responses must also explain how they would accomplish the CCDI productionization effort and provide a timeline including major milestones to support BAE Systems� CCDI production delivery requirements beginning in December 2030. This would include ensuring the offered productionized CCDI design is completed and is AIMS 17-1000 Rev 1 Box certified, including integration of internal target processing that meets the existing Combat System performance required by AWS and SSDS (in accordance with all applicable Weapon Specifications). 4.0 INCUMBENT This is a follow-on requirement. The Original Equipment Manufacturer is BAE Systems, Information and Electronic Systems Integration, 450 Pulaski Rd. Greenlawn, NY 11740USA. 5.0 ELIGIBILITY The Product and Service Code for this requirement is 5840. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 334511 (Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing), with a small business size standard of 1,350 employees as defined by the U.S. Small Business Administration. The Government currently anticipates a sole-source award under FAR 6.103-1 to BAE Systems due to the Government�s lack of required technical data and data rights for the AN/UPX-50 DI designs. However, all responsible sources, including small business (8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB) are encouraged to submit capability statements describing their ability to perform as a prime or subcontractor and to identify any specific portions of the requirement they can perform. All interested contractors must be registered in the System for Award Management government website at www.sam.gov to be eligible for award of Government contracts. Only interested firms who possess the supplies and services provided in this notice and can meet these requirements are invited to respond. The Government will not reimburse participants for any expenses associated with their participation in this notice. 6.0 SUBMITTAL INFORMATION It is requested that interested vendors submit to the point of contract below, a brief capabilities statement package (no more than 10 - 8.5 x 11 pages in length, single-spaced, 12-point font minimum) demonstrating the capability to meet the requirements of this notice. This documentation must address, at a minimum, the following: A company profile to include: Company name, business size under NAICS Code 334511, office location(s), Point of Contact name, phone number, email address, Commercial and Government Entity code, and Unique Entity ID. Include a brief description of any applicable contracts relating to the supplies and/or services described herein. Prior/current industry experience of similar size and scope as referenced in section 3.0 �Required Capabilities�. Address the proposed management approach to staffing the effort with qualified personnel. Include corporate management policies, quality certifications, and the experience level of currently employed personnel to be assigned tasks under this effort. Provide documentation of the company's ability to begin performance immediately upon contract award projected in December 2026, to include a detailed plan and estimated schedule(s) of performance. Include any deviation or impact, if applicable. Any anticipated schedule, cost, or technical risks associated with performing this effort as a non-OEM source, and proposed mitigations. Provide documentation to show the company's ability to meet the Required Capabilities and Eligibility of this notice to include: Whether your company possesses, or can obtain access to the technical data, software documentation, and data rights necessary to perform this effort or describe an alternative technical approach that meets all interface, performance, qualification, and certification requirements without access to OEM proprietary information. Responses shall not contain classified information. If a response includes proprietary information, it shall be clearly marked as such. The Government will handle all proprietary information in accordance with applicable law and regulations and will not disclose it outside the Government without prior permission. description: This is a combined Sources Sought/Request for Information (RFI) notice. Any information submitted by respondents to this request is strictly voluntary. Based on the review of responses to this Sources Sought/RFI notice, the Government may elect to release a formal Request for Proposal (RFP) at a future date. (O): Full support for all Threshold modes plus native cryptographic integration for secure military Mode 5 e. SSR Probability of Detection (Pd) (T): 90% or higher. (O): 95% or higher. 3.3.2 Precision Landing a. PAR Coverage & Switch Time (T): Service up to 6 runways, switchable within 60 seconds. (O): Service > 6 runways, switchable in under 30 seconds. b. PAR Instrumented Range (T): Reliable azimuth/elevation tracking and detection out to a minimum range of 10 NM. (O): Reliable azimuth/elevation tracking and detection out to 20 NM or greater. c. ATC Radio Communications (T): Each ATC position must have UHF/VHF transmit/receive capability and the ability to simultaneously monitor UHF/VHF Guard frequencies. (O): Fully integrated voice switch system with secure, encrypted transmit/receive capability. 3.3.4 System Reliability & Redundancy (T=O): Backup PSR transmitter or redundancy in the system is required. Backup power (UPS) is required. Mean Time Between Critical Failure (MTBCF) > 2,000 hours. 3.3.5 Maintainability (MTTR) (T): Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) < 30 minutes. title: Limited Source Delivery Order for Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS) Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) Services under existing Basic Ordering Agreements � Order 3
description: The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIRSYSCOM) on behalf of the Aircraft Program Management Office (AIR PMO), acting under the Portfolio Acquisition Executive for Robotic and Autonomous Systems (PAE RAS) at Patuxent River, MD, intends to compete and award a limited source Firm Fixed Price (FFP) type Delivery Order. This order will be competed under one of four existing Basic Ordering Agreements (BOAs) to the below vendors for the procurement of Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS) Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) Maritime Services: N0001925G1000: Insitu, Inc. (Insitu), East Columbia Way, Bingen, WA N0001926G1005: AeroVironment (AV), 900 Innovators Way, Simi Valley, CA N0001926G1006: Shield AI (Shield), 600 West Broadway, San Diego, CA N0001926G1007: Textron Systems (Textron), 124 Industry Lane, Hunt Valley, MD The delivery order will secure contractor-owned, contractor-operated UAS ISR services utilizing Maritime B-kits #7-#9 in support of multiple combatant commands. Contractors will be responsible for resources to produce sensor data, such as trained personnel, non-developmental UAS equipment, shipboard operations and logistics Conex containers, certifications, operation and maintenance, SpaceX Starshield SATCOM-capable hardware, spares, and product support. Contracted services would be in direct support of ISR missions requiring around-the-clock imagery and other sensor capability in support of those missions. It is anticipated that these services will support domestic and coalition military partners in combat and contingency operations based on Joint Urgent Operational Needs (JUONs), Fleet Top Level Requirements (TLR), and other operational requirements documents. The total period of performance includes a base period and four (4) option periods (to include environmental shock testing and training options) for up to 60 months of service. THIS NOTICE IS PUBLISHED FOR INFORMATION PURPOSES ONLY AND IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS. A determination by the Government to compete this procurement under the existing BOA, regardless of responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the Government. The Government will not pay for any responses received. There are no commitments by the Government to issue any solicitations, make an award or awards, or to be responsible for any monies expended by any interested parties before award of a contract for the efforts mentioned above. Information provided herein is subject to change and in no way binds the Government to solicit for or award a contract. No telephone responses will be accepted. Information provided herein is subject to change and in no way binds the Government to solicit for or award a delivery order.

title: Denmark – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Udbud af WMS til nyt Lager- & Logistikcenter til Esbjerg Sygehus
description: Region Syddanmark udbyder en kontrakt vedrørende Warehouse Management System (WMS) til det nye Lager- & Logistikcenter Esbjerg Sygehus. Esbjerg Sygehus’ fysiske rammer for Depot & Forsyningstjenesten er 100% udnyttet og kan ikke understøtte den ønskede vækst og fremtidssikring, som det kræves. Depot & Forsyningstjenesten holder til i kælderetagen på Esbjerg Sygehus i dag, hvor alle varer bliver leveret på Østergade i indre by af Esbjerg. Esbjerg Sygehus nye Lager- & Logistikcenter vil danne rammerne for en øgning af varer på lageret som sikre forsyningen til Esbjerg Sygehus og samarbejdspartnere. Øgningen af lagervarer giver et positivt aftryk på den grønne omstilling i form af reduktion i transporter til Lager- & Logistikcenteret i forhold til den nuværende belastning. Den tunge og sorte trafik i Esbjerg indre by vil blive reduceret væsentlig ved etablering af Esbjerg Sygehus’ nye Lager- & Logistikcenter. Esbjerg Sygehus Lager- & Logistikcenter forsyner Esbjerg & Grindsted Sygehus, Veneklinikken i Brørup, Psykiatrien på Gl. Vardevej og alle de lokale Psykiatri afdelinger. Esbjerg Sygehus har samarbejde med de omkringliggende kommuner vedr. blandt andet IV behandlinger i borgernes eget hjem samt de kommende Sundheds- og Omsorgs Pladser. Samarbejdet indeholder en aftale med forsyninger til lokale depoter i samarbejdskommunerne. Den udbudte opgave omfatter levering, implementering, konfiguration og tilpasning af WMS, herunder etablering af integrationer, uddannelse af superbrugere og brugere, prøver og test samt idriftsættelse, drift, support og vedligeholdelse. På tidspunktet for indgåelse af den udbudte Kontrakt er lagerbygningen under opførelse. Leverandørens ydelser omfatter tillige projektledelse og koordinering med entreprenøren – KG Hansen, dog primært med leverandøren af AutoStore og Conveyor anlæg – Element Logic. WMS-løsningen som leveres, i henhold til den udbudte Kontrakt, skal opfylde de krav til funktion, kvalitet, kapacitet m.v., som fremgår af udbudsmaterialet. Regionen har behov for op til 2 sites med 3 superbrugere og 12 brugere. Det ene site skal anvendes for Esbjerg Sygehus som en del af Leverancen, og det andet site skal kobles på for Grindsted Sygehus i løbet af kontraktperioden uden yderligere omkostninger. Grindsted Sygehus har ikke et tilsvarende WMS, men alene manuelle lagre. Opgaven er udbudt som én samlet kontrakt ud fra funktionelle, markedsmæssige og økonomiske hensyn. Kontrakten er tidsubegrænset. Kunden har et opsigelsesvarsel på 12 måneder, og Leverandøren har et opsigelsesvarsel på 24 måneder, dog tidligst til udløb 5 år efter Overtagelsesdagen.

title: Germany – Electricity, heating, solar and nuclear energy – Lieferung von elektrischer Energie Ökostrom für diverse Abnahmestellen von Trägern öffentlicher Verwaltungen im Bundesland Schleswig-Holstein
description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Lieferung von elektrischer Energie (100 % Ökostrom) als Vollstromversorgung für die in den Vergabeunterlagen bezeichneten Abnahmestellen der Auftraggeber. Der zur Versorgung der Abnahmestellen gelieferte Strom muss zu 100 % aus erneuerbaren Energien stammen. Ökostrom im Sinne dieser Ausschreibung ist Strom, der aus erneuerbaren Energiequellen erzeugt wird. Zulässige Energiequellen sind insbesondere: Wasserkraft einschließlich Wellen-, Gezeiten-, Salzgradienten- und Strömungsenergie, Windenergie, solare Strahlungsenergie, Geothermie, Biomasse einschließlich Biogas, Deponiegas und Klärgas sowie der biologisch abbaubare Anteil von Abfällen aus Haushalten und Industrie. Soweit Strom aus Biomasse eingesetzt wird, müssen die jeweils geltenden gesetzlichen Anforderungen an die eingesetzten Energieträger sowie, soweit einschlägig, die gesetzlichen Nachhaltigkeitsanforderungen erfüllt sein. Strom aus Kernenergie sowie Strom, der aus fossilen Energieträgern, insbesondere Kohle, Erdgas oder Mineralöl, erzeugt wurde, erfüllt die Anforderungen dieser Ausschreibung nicht. Dies gilt auch für Strom aus Kraft-Wärme-Kopplungsanlagen, soweit dieser unter Einsatz fossiler Energieträger erzeugt wurde. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Die Ausschreibung umfasst insgesamt 2 Lose mit ca. 499 Abnahmestellen und einem jährlichen Gesamtverbrauch von ca. 4,3 GWh. Die Abnahmestellen der Teilnehmer wurden von der ausschreibenden Stelle auf 2 Lose verteilt. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Die tatsächlichen Verbräuche im Lieferzeitraum können nutzungsbedingt von den ermittelten Verbräuchen auf Basis der Verbrauchsdaten im Referenzjahr abweichen. Die Anzahl der Verbrauchseinrichtungen kann ebenfalls während der Vertragslaufzeit variieren. Wegen weiterer Einzelheiten wird auf die Vorbemerkungen zum Stromliefervertrag verwiesen. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Toleranzband: Für das Lieferjahr 2027 gilt für jeden Auftraggeber ein Toleranzband von ± 10 % der für diesen Auftraggeber maßgeblichen Gesamt-Referenzmenge. Die Mindestabnahmemenge zu den vereinbarten Lieferkonditionen beträgt je Auftraggeber 90 % der Gesamt-Referenzmenge des Lieferjahres 2027. Die Maximalabnahmemenge zu den vereinbarten Lieferkonditionen beträgt je Auftraggeber 110 % der Gesamt-Referenzmenge des Lieferjahres 2027. Für die Prüfung des Toleranzbandes werden die tatsächlichen Verbrauchsmengen sämtlicher im Lieferjahr 2027 zur Versorgung angemeldeter Abnahmestellen des jeweiligen Auftraggebers gemeinsam betrachtet. Soweit innerhalb eines Auftraggebers unterschiedliche Preis- oder Messgruppen bestehen, werden deren Verbrauchsmengen für die Prüfung des Toleranzbandes zusammengefasst. Verbrauchsabweichungen innerhalb des Toleranzbandes führen zu keiner gesonderten Mehr- oder Mindermengenabrechnung. Eine gesonderte Mehr- oder Mindermengenabrechnung kann ausschließlich für Verbrauchsmengen erfolgen, die außerhalb des vorstehend festgelegten Toleranzbandes liegen. Hinsichtlich der Einzelheiten der Mehr- und Mindermengenabrechnung wird auf Ziffer 10 dieser Leistungsbeschreibung verwiesen. Die Betrachtung des Toleranzbandes erfolgt für jeden Teilnehmer gesondert. Maßgeblich ist die Summe der tatsächlichen Verbrauchsmengen sämtlicher im Lieferjahr 2027 zur Versorgung angemeldeter Abnahmestellen des jeweiligen Teilnehmers im Verhältnis zu dessen Gesamt-Referenzmenge. Ein Ausgleich von Mehr- oder Minderverbräuchen zwischen verschiedenen Teilnehmern desselben Loses findet nicht statt. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Die maximal beziehbare Energiemenge beträgt für das Lieferjahr 2027 je Auftraggeber 150 % der für diesen Auftraggeber maßgeblichen Gesamt-Referenzmenge. Unabhängig hiervon beträgt die absolute Höchstmenge der im Rahmen des jeweiligen Loses insgesamt beziehbaren Energie 150 % der für das betreffende Los ausgewiesenen Gesamt-Referenzmenge. Der Mengenbereich zwischen 110 % und 150 % der jeweiligen Gesamt-Referenzmenge gehört nicht zum Toleranzband und wird nach den Regelungen zur Mehrmengenabrechnung abgerechnet. Die vorstehenden Höchstmengen stellen keine Abnahmeverpflichtung des Auftraggebers dar. Eine Verpflichtung zur Abnahme besteht ausschließlich nach Maßgabe der Regelungen zum Toleranzband und der sonstigen Vertragsbestimmungen. Mit Erreichen der für das jeweilige Los festgelegten absoluten Höchstmenge können aus der Rahmenvereinbarung keine weiteren Liefermengen zu den Bedingungen dieser Ausschreibung verlangt werden. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Pro Los wird ein Rahmenvertrag mit einem Anbieter geschlossen. Es erfolgt keine Los- oder Zuschlagslimitierung.

title: Germany – Floor-covering work – Berufliche Schulen Kehl, Sanierung Gebäude G, Bodenbelagsarbeiten
description: Die Abmessungen des Gebäudes betragen im Grundriss ca. 50,0 x 14,5 m. Bodenbelagsarbeiten sollen ab Dezember 2026 durchgeführt werden. Folgende Bodenbelagsarbeiten stehen an: 8 Stk Messung Estrichfeuchte, ca. 2.400 m2 Bodenbelag Linoleum, ausbauen, entsorgen, ca. 2.400 m2 Schleifen des Untergrundes, 150 m2 Untergrund fräsen, 450 lfm Randdämmstreifen entfernen + entsorgen, 1.000 lfm Randdämmstreifen erneuern, 700 lfm Risse verharzen und schließen, 456 lfm Bestandsestrich schneiden, 456 lfm Anschlussverbinder liefern und einbauen, 300 m2 Trittschalldämmung, 300 m2 Trennlage, 300 m2 Estrich ergänzen, 250m2 Estrich ausbessern bis ca. 5cm, ca.2.500 m2 Haftgrund auf Unterboden, ca.2.500 m2 Grundierung 2K-Epoxidharz Spachtel 5-8 mm, ca.2.500 m2 Spachtelung mit Ausgleichsmasse d= 3 mm, 8 Stk Haftzugprüfung, ca.2.500 m2 Linoleum-Belag 2,5 mm R9, 42 Stk Fugenverschluss Silikon an Zarge, ca.1.500 lfm Sockelleiste Kunststoff 12 x 60mm,2 Stück Sauberlaufmatte 2,00x2,00m, 20 lfm Profile Belagswechsel, 10 Stk Bodenschiene für Brandschutztür, 10lfm Dehnungsfugenprofil Alu, ca.2500 m2 Schutzabdeckung mit Milchtütenpapier, ca.2500 m2 Erstpflege Bodenbelag Linoleum Das Landratsamt Ortenaukreis beabsichtigt für seinen Innensanierung der Beruflichen Schulen in Kehl die Leistung Bodenbelagsarbeiten zu vergeben. Der Gebäudekomplex der Beruflichen Schulen Kehl, bestehend aus den Gebäudeteilen H, G, N und Verbindungsbau V, wurde in den 1960er Jahren errichtet. Im Lauf der Jahrzehnte wurde die Schule immer wieder modernisiert, zuletzt im Rahmen einer energetischen Sanierung mit Erneuerung der Fassaden. Der Gebäudeteil G umfasst ein Erdgeschoss, drei Obergeschosse, Teilunterkellerung und eine Unterkellerung in Form eines nicht begehbaren Kriechkellers mit Installationsleitungen. Ziel der Innensanierung ist die Verbesserung der Brandschutztechnischen Bestandssituation, die Aufwertung der sanierungsbedürftigen Räume und die Anpassung der räumlichen Situation an den aktuellen Bedarf. Durch die Sanierung kommt es zur Anpassung einiger Klassenzimmer die an den Bedarf der aktuellen Schülerzahlen angepasst und optimiert werden. Auch kommt es zur Umverlegung einzelner Fachräume sowie des Verwaltungstraktes innerhalb des Bestandes sodass auch der Barrierefreiheit in einem verhältnismäßigen Maß Sorge getragen wird. Darüber hinaus werden im öffentlichen Bereich vor dem neuen Verwaltungsbereich zusätzlich neue Sanitärbereiche mit einem zusätzlich barrierefreien WC errichtet.

title: Germany – Business and management consultancy services – 10009293-Development of inclusive financial services and products
description: Iraq faces a persistent gap between its people and the financial system. Banks have long leaned on large state-owned institutions, credit has flowed mainly to established borrowers, and micro and small businesses along with women entrepreneurs and displaced communities have been largely left out. ProDIGI project, full name Promoting Employment in the Digital and Green Economy in Iraq, is trying to change that in a practical, grounded way. ProDIGI is a multi-donor initiative commissioned by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ), co-financed by the European Union, and implemented by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH. The project covers central and southern Iraq as well as the Kurdistan Region, with a focus on areas where joblessness, displacement, and limited access to services overlap. Within the project, Output 3 targets the financial inclusion side of the challenge. The starting point is a clear-eyed look at what the sector lacks: financial service providers that are capable, willing, and equipped to design products that fit the people they are supposed to serve. Banks and microfinance institutions in Iraq today mostly offer standardised products with high collateral requirements and limited digital capabilities. Reaching women led small businesses, rural communities, or young entrepreneurs running green or tech ventures requires a different kind of product, and often a different kind of institution. To bridge that gap, the project works directly with Iraqi financial service providers: banks, microfinance institutions, digital payment companies, fintechs, and government lending programmes. The approach combines needs assessments, hands-on advisory services, staff training, product design support, and pilot testing. The goal is not to deliver a finished product from outside, but to build the knowledge and process capacity within each institution so that change remains after the project ends. By the close of the assignment, at least three new or significantly adapted financial products must be in place, and these products must be actively reaching real users at a minimum of 950 individuals and 50 companies. The work also emphasises gender equality: women-led businesses are a priority target group, and all capacity-building activities must include a meaningful share of women participants. The broader context matters too. Iraq's Central Bank launched the national financial inclusion strategy that encourages digital payments, SME lending, and consumer protection improvements. ProDIGI project aligns directly with those priorities, making it both a practical intervention at the level of individual institutions and a contribution to the country's wider financial sector development. The selected firm will work directly with three to five financial service providers (FSPs) operating in Iraq. These may include commercial banks, microfinance institutions, digital payment providers, fintechs, and government lending schemes. GIZ will have pre-selected up to two FSPs before the contract starts, so work can begin without delay. The remaining FSPs will be selected by the contractor and GIZ jointly, based on agreed criteria.

title: Switzerland – Structural shell work – Submission 211 Baumeister Anbau und Aufstockung AZB, Breitenbach
description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung sind die Baumeisterarbeiten im Zusammenhang mit der geplanten Erweiterung und dem Umbau des bestehenden Alterszentrums Breitenbach. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst sämtliche für die Realisierung des Rohbaus erforderlichen Baumeisterarbeiten. Dazu gehören insbesondere die Baustelleneinrichtung, erforderliche Abbruch- und Rückbauarbeiten, Erd- und Aushubarbeiten, Kanalisations- und Entwässerungsarbeiten, Fundationen, Beton- und Stahlbetonarbeiten, Schalungs- und Bewehrungsarbeiten, Mauerwerksarbeiten sowie ergänzende Arbeiten am bestehenden Gebäude. Weiter sind die erforderlichen Durchbrüche, Aussparungen, Schlitze, Kernbohrungen und Anpassungsarbeiten im Bestand sowie das fachgerechte Schliessen von Öffnungen und Aussparungen Bestandteil der ausgeschriebenen Leistungen. Ebenfalls enthalten sind sämtliche notwendigen Nebenarbeiten, Transporte, Materialumschläge und Koordinationsleistungen gemäss den Ausschreibungsunterlagen. Ein wesentlicher Bestandteil des Auftrags sind die Anschlüsse zwischen dem bestehenden Gebäude und der Erweiterung. Die Arbeiten sind entsprechend den Projekt- und Ausführungsunterlagen sowie den geltenden Normen, Vorschriften und behördlichen Vorgaben auszuführen. Da das Alterszentrum während der Bauzeit weiterhin betrieben wird, sind die Arbeiten etappenweise und unter besonderer Berücksichtigung des laufenden Betriebs auszuführen. Zugänge, Flucht- und Rettungswege sowie die betrieblich notwendigen Erschliessungen sind jederzeit gemäss Bauablauf und Vorgaben der Bauleitung sicherzustellen. Die Ausführung erfordert eine enge terminliche und technische Koordination mit der Bauleitung sowie mit den übrigen am Bau beteiligten Unternehmern. Die Arbeiten sind gemäss Bauprogramm, Leistungsverzeichnis und den weiteren Bestandteilen der Ausschreibungsunterlagen auszuführen.

Przedmiot zamówienia obejmuje: 1) Zadanie Nr 1 (w podstawowym przedmiocie zamówienia): wykonanie usługi polegającej na zagospodarowaniu zielenią terenów miejskich w dziesięciu Lokalizacjach wskazanych w SWZ. 2) Zadanie Nr 2 (usługa objęta prawem opcji) : a) utrzymanie i pielęgnacja wykonanych zagospodarowań w okresie od 15.04.2027r. – 15.10.2027r. w Lokalizacjach wskazanych w SWZ; zgodnie z załączoną dokumentacją projektowo-kosztorysową dla poszczególnych Lokalizacji, b) maksymalna wartość prawa opcji – 29.183,70 PLN, c) Zamawiający uzależnia skorzystanie z prawa opcji od możliwości finansowych, pozwalających na ich wykonanie. 3. Przedmiot umowy dla Zadania Nr 1 zakłada wykonanie usługi dla poszczególnych lokalizacji zgodnie z zakresami projektowymi i zamieszczonymi przedmiarami i obejmuje m. in: 1) Prace rozbiórkowe w zakresie nawierzchni, 2) oczyszczenie i przygotowanie terenu pod nasadzenia, 3) posadzenie roślin, prace wykończeniowe i pielęgnacyjne. 4. Szczegółowe opisy przedmiotu zamówienia dla Zadania Nr 1 oraz wymagania związane z jego wykonaniem określa Załącznik Nr 1 do SWZ zawierając projekty dla poszczególnych Lokalizacji, w tym: 1) Przedmiary robót, 2) Opisy techniczne, 3) Rysunki techniczne: PZT i PW, 4) Specyfikacje techniczne wykonania i odbioru robót. 5. Szczegółowy zakres usług dla Zadania Nr 2 i sposób ich wykonania znajduje się w dokumentacji projektowej. RAPORTY PIELĘGNACYJNE - Wykonawca zobowiązany jest systematycznie wykonywać zabiegi pielęgnacyjne i informować Zamawiającego e-mailowo (najpóźniej w dniu poprzedzającym wykonywanie planowanych prac) o terminie, lokalizacji oraz rodzaju planowanych zabiegów pielęgnacyjnych.

title: SOURCES SOUGHT W58RGZ-27-R-A015 UH-60, GENERATOR APU, AIRCR INSPECTION AND OVERHAUL
description: SOURCES SOUGHT W58RGZ-27-R-A015 UH-60, GENERATOR APU, AIRCR INSPECTION AND OVERHAUL INTRODUCTION The U.S. Army Contracting Command-Redstone Arsenal (W58RGZ) ATTN: CCAM-AVA-B, Building 5303, Martin Road Redstone Arsenal, AL 35898-5280 (US) is issuing this Sources Sought as a means of conducting market research to identify potential sources having an interest and industry technologies available to support/provide inspection and overhaul of the GENERATOR APU, AIRCR. Input: GENERATOR APU, AIRCR NSN: 1680-01-480-6542, part number 70550-85901-104. Output: GENERATOR APU, AIRCR NSN: 1680-01-480-6542, part number 70550-85901-104. The resulting contract will be a single award, Firm Fixed-Price, Five Year (IDIQ) Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity, with a min/max 14/89, US QTY 74, FMS QTY 15. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement, if a requirement materializes. Based on the responses to this Sources Sought notice and market research, this requirement may be set aside for small businesses (in full or in part) or procured through full and open competition. Multiple awards may be made. All small business set-aside categories will be considered. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or acknowledged, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to companies regarding submissions. DISCLAIMER THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP) TO BE SUBMITTED. IT DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A SOLICITATION AND SHALL NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT. RESPONSES IN ANY FORM ARE NOT OFFERS AND THE GOVERNMENT IS UNDER NO OBLIGATION TO AWARD A CONTRACT AS A RESULT OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. NO FUNDS ARE AVAILABLE TO PAY FOR PREPARATION OF RESPONSES TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. ANY INFORMATION SUBMITTED BY RESPONDENTS TO THIS TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION IS STRICTLY VOLUNTARY. REQUIRED CAPABILITIES The Government requires that contractors be able to provide all services, facilities, labor, parts, materials, equipment, tools, and data necessary to accomplish the inspection and overhaul for the GENERATOR APU, AIRCR, and to return the items to condition code A as defined by Army Regulation 725-50. Upon completion of the overhaul, the items shall be packaged and shipped to the required destination(s). The GENERATOR APU, AIRCR, is a non-Critical Safety Item. A DMWR is not available. The only known sources for this item are Sikorsky Aircraft Corp (Cage: 78286), Sherwood Aviation (Cage: 3EM37) and Honeywell International Inc (Cage: 64547). SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS The Government requires that contractors have a plan to meet all the Government�s special tooling and test equipment requirements with either: 1. Physical possession of the required tools, 2. Confirmed requisitions for the required tools, 3. Confirmed arrangements for subcontracting the processes requiring the special tools, or 4. Specific plans describing their technical approach to develop equivalent tools. ELIGIBILITY The applicable NAICS code for this requirement is 336413 with a Small Business Size Standard of 1,000. The Product Service Code (PSC) is 1680. SUBMISSION DETAILS Interested parties who have the capability to provide the item listed above please submit a brief capabilities statement package (no more than ten 8.5 X 11 inch pages, font no smaller than 10 point) demonstrating ability to provide the products/systems. This submission does not replace the requirement listed above on becoming an approved source. This announcement is for information and planning purposes only and should not be construed as a commitment by the Government for any purposes. This announcement does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP). A synopsis will be issued at a later date for this requirement. Requests for a solicitation will not receive a response. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this announcement and any follow-up information requested. No basis for claim against the Government shall arise as a result of a response to this announcement or Government use of any information provided. This announcement does not restrict the Government to an ultimate acquisition strategy. The Government reserves the right to consider acquisition strategies as deemed appropriate. No phone or email solicitations with regards to the status of the RFP will be accepted prior to its release. Your response to this Sources Sought, including the technical survey, shall be electronically submitted to the Contract Specialist, Jason Howell in either Microsoft Word or Portable Document Format (PDF), via email jason.l.howell4.civ@army.mil no later than 1700 p.m. Central Time 15 days after the posting of this document and reference the solicitation number in the subject line of the e-mail and on all enclosed documents. Information and materials submitted in response to this request WILL NOT be returned. DO NOT SUBMIT CLASSIFIED MATERIAL. If your organization has the potential capacity to provide the required products/systems, please provide the following information: 1) Organization name, address, primary points of contact (POCs) and their email address, Web site address, telephone number, and type of ownership for the organization; and 2) Tailored capability statements addressing the requirements of this notice, with appropriate documentation supporting claims of organizational and staff capability. If significant subcontracting or teaming is anticipated in order to deliver technical capability, organizations should address the administrative and management structure of such arrangements. All data received in response to this Sources Sought that is marked or designated as corporate or proprietary will be fully protected from any release outside the Government.

title: Inhaled Nitric Oxide
description: NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE: The Defense Health Agency � Healthcare Contracting Division � South, intends to award a sole source contract in accordance with RFO FAR 8.104 (Use of Existing Contracts) to INO THERAPEUTICS LLC, to procure delivery of Inhaled Nitric Oxide (iNO) for use at the Department of Medicine. at Brooke Army Medical Center, Fort Sam Houston, Texas. The period of performance is 01 JAN 2027 � 31 DEC 2027, plus four (4) option years. This notice serves to announce the Government�s intent to sole source this requirement and determine if any other sources exist. Interested sources with the demonstrated capability to meet all of the technical requirements outlined in this notice are invited to submit, in writing. Responses must include clear and convincing evidence that competition would be beneficial to the Government and would not be cost or schedule prohibitive. Respondents are responsible for appropriately marking any proprietary information. Responses will not be returned. The contractor shall deliver the following crucial elements: (a) the supply of nitric oxide for inhalation, the pharmaceutical drug essential for the therapy (800 parts per million [PPM]); (b) a specialized Delivery Device that meets the precise criteria outlined in the iNO product label for safe and effective administration, (c) all necessary maintenance and calibration items, accessories, and disposable supplies required for the ongoing operation of the system, and (d) a range of support services, including training, maintenance, pick-up and delivery logistics. title: LRASM B-52 Integration and Test Support
description: The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR) intends to enter into sole source negotiations and subsequently award a Cost Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF) Delivery Order (DO) to Lockheed Martin Corporation-Missiles Fire Control (LMMFC) against Basic Ordering Agreement (BOA) N00019-23-G-0002. The anticipated DO is for efforts associated with LRASM integration on the B-52 aircraft platform, to include missile software updates, associated testing, test asset repair, and failure review boards. This contract is being pursued on a sole source basis under the statutory authority of 10 U.S.C. 2304 (c)(1) as implemented by Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Subpart 6.302-1, only one responsible source and no other services will satisfy agency requirements. All responsible sources may submit a capability statement, proposal, or quotation, which shall be considered by the agency. Unless stated herein, no additional information is available. Requests for the same will be disregarded. A determination by the Government not to compete this effort is solely within the discretion of the Government. Lockheed Martin is the sole designer, developer, manufacturer, and integrator of the Long-Range Anti-Ship Missile (LRASM). LMMFC alone has the requisite knowledge, experience, and technical data that can meet the Government's requirements within the required timeframe. Accordingly, LMMFC is the only known, qualified, responsible source that can fulfill the requirements specified herein. Subcontracting opportunities may be available and should be sought with Lockheed Martin via the Lockheed Martin Supplier Wire, a dedicated site for suppliers, at www.lockheedmartin.com/enus/suppliers.html. There is no commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation, make an award or awards, or to be responsible for any monies expended by any interested parties before award of a delivery order for the effort mentioned above. Information provided herein is subject to change and in no way binds the Government to solicit for or award a contract.

description: The OFFERS DUE DATE is being pushed back to Oct. 22,2026. Currently, RFIs are being answered and additional time is needed. RSVP for the site visit by August 13, 2026 to Mark Lovie at mark.lovie@gsa.gov. His cell number is (415)961-0222. Ensure you CC' john.morelion@gsa.gov. 3. RFI's will be due August 26, 2026. 4. Offers will be due September 03, 2026 by 4:30PM MST. All Offer should be emailed to john.morelion@gsa.gov Please be reminded to bring your verification of ID to the site visit. The amendment will be an attachment include a signed copy with your offer. The U.S. General Services Administration intends to solicit construction services for the Turner Roof & Building Envelope Project at the Turner Land Port of Entry, 41725 Turner Road, Turner, Montana 59542, Building No. MT0055AW. The project includes roof replacement and building envelope improvements at the main building, including work on the U.S. and Canadian sides of the facility, and envelope improvements at the water treatment building. Work includes, but is not limited to, selective demolition, roof replacement, exterior wall/cladding repairs, thermal and moisture protection, metals, openings, finishes, and incidental electrical, communications, and securityrelated coordination. The facility will remain occupied and operational during construction. The contractor must phase and secure the work daily, maintain safe access, protect ongoing border operations, and coordinate with GSA, CBP, CBSA, and other stakeholders regarding antennas, cameras, cables, signs, access, security, and inspections. Work affecting the Canadian side may require Canadian access, work permit, and material import coordination.Certain roofing materials may be furnished through the existing roofing warranty process; the contractor will be responsible for coordinating those materials with the manufacturer/certified installer and providing all remaining labor, materials, equipment, supervision, bonds, permits, and incidentals required to complete the work. The contractor shall comply with the solicitation documents, drawings, specifications, applicable codes and standards, GSA PBS Core Building Standards, security and badging requirements, environmental survey requirements, fire/life safety requirements, submittal requirements, and closeout requirements. The anticipated period of performance is 150 calendar days after notice to proceed. The solicitation is expected to include base bid work for the main building roof and envelope on the U.S. side, main building roof and envelope on the Canadian side, and water treatment building envelope work on the U.S. side.
